title: Avtolos (or Avtolmos) bar Reuven
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in Sotah 49b and Bava Kamma 83b: he was close to the government, and they therefore permitted him to cut his hair in the komi style.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied Bava Kamma locator is פג:, 83b. The saved William Davidson Sotah 49b paragraph supports the government connection and komi haircut and writes ben Reuven where Hyman has bar Reuven; no Bava Kamma paragraph has been inspected in this comparison.

The whole Davidson Sotah 49b paragraph has Avtolos ben Reuven; the matching whole Bava Kamma 83a paragraph has Avtolmos bar Reuven and the government connection and komi permission. All twenty-two paragraphs of digital Bava Kamma 83b were also read and do not contain this account. Hyman’s supplied 83b locator and both heading forms remain unchanged. The earlier note records the earlier comparison; this new comparison supplies the additional bounded evidence without asserting a printed correction or identity merge.
